caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition, divided into three vertical panels in the lower half and a single horizontal frieze in the upper half, all bordered by a decorative frame. The color palette primarily consists of red, green, blue, gold, and black, with accents of brown and white. The lower central panel depicts a crowned woman in blue and a crowned man in brown holding a child, who is also crowned and dressed in red, all standing close together. The left lower panel contains a figure wearing a crown and white robe with red lining, holding a black cross and standing outdoors with some green trees visible. The right lower panel has a crowned, winged figure in green and red, holding a large white disc, with a tall, grey turreted building next to them and a bright golden burst behind the disc. The three lower panels are separated by twisted columns painted in alternating stripes of red, green, and blue with gold bases and tops. Above these panels, the upper third of the drawing contains three seated, haloed figures in red with grey head coverings on a green background, the central figure holding a book, the left figure holding a cross, and the right figure holding a rod. The corners and background are decorated with swirling red, green, and gold patterns, floral motifs, and intricate geometric designs.
title: Laguna Main Altarpiece
